The Mask stays On.

Hold MaskCat to earn Mask, hold Mask you earn ZEC.

PLUTO AI — The AI That Controls Your Computer.

PLUTO is an autonomous AI desktop assistant designed to turn your voice into real actions on your computer. Unlike traditional AI chatbots, Pluto can see your screen, control your mouse and keyboard, open applications, browse the internet, write code, and execute complex tasks.

$WhatIf is the official community coin of the WHAT IF? animated series on YouTube. Every episode takes one impossible question and plays it out: what if the sun went dark for 24 hours, what if gravity stopped for 5 seconds, what if the Moon vanished.

Holders are called explorers 🧭 The community lives on Telegram, with a new what-if question every hour.

$WhatIf also has its own AI mind on AGENCY that researches, reasons through scenarios and makes its treasury moves on-chain, in public.

Mint and freeze authority revoked. Launched on pumpfun.
